head_commit.message:
fix(p4-1): serialize native R2 metadata as a plain object

Repair P41-NATIVE-01 without changing upload integrity or registration gates.
Exercise actual uploader arguments through the pinned Miniflare codec and
retain old Node Headers rejection, three asset kinds and readback failures.
Local development feedback is recorded; v1 PRODUCT_FAIL remains unchanged.
